column1: # survey: Custom Work Charges in Maryland and Delaware (University of Maryland Extension FS-683, updated March 2025), Table 1
# publisher: University of Maryland Extension, with the University of Delaware
# collected: Mail and online survey in the fall of 2024; 61 custom operators and farmers gave the rates they charge

# includes: Reported rates include charges for machines, power, fuel, lube and the labor/operator. They do not include chemicals, seed or other materials, except hay baling materials and where noted (spreading lime includes the lime).

# range_note: The range is the lowest and highest answer. The guide prints the average and the median but not how many answered each job; a job whose lowest, highest, median and average are all one number may rest on a single answer, so it is shown but never lined up with other states. The bed forming and plastic laying line names no unit and is left out.
